item.title: september 25 - october 1
item.description: your no-frills community newsletter for art + culture events around kathmandu, every fri-thurs.
item.content:encoded:
friday – september 25

fri 4:30pm: FILM – knowledge-making beyond text a screening of marshyangdi wile riba followed by a panel on environmental harm, audiovisual storytelling, and collaboration across research, art, and local communities.
Yalamaya Kendra, Patan Dhoka, registration required, instagram »


fri 5pm: FILM – have you seen my gods? + shiva linga: a visual quest a screening of two films exploring sacred imagery and cultural traditions.
Taragaon Next, Boudha, free entry, instagram »


fri 5pm: EXHIBITION – untitled a solo exhibition by taiwanese artist xinwei huang, presenting new work developed during her time in nepal through the air_mcube international artists residency.
Gallery Mcube, Chakupat, instagram »


fri 5:30pm: FILM – on ira a french comedy-drama following an unexpected family road trip that brings moments of connection, joy, and reconciliation, presented as a special screening for suicide prevention month.
Alliance Française, Pulchowk, free entry, instagram »


fri 7pm: MUSIC – music nights: nudisco/house abiral takes over the rooftop with a night of nu-disco and house music.
The Village Café Rooftop, Jhamsikhel, instagram »

saturday – september 26

sat 2pm: FILM – little miss sunshine a special screening followed by open conversations around family, vulnerability, connection, and navigating difficult moments together.
Oscar International College, Gaushala, registration required, instagram »


sat 3pm: WORKSHOP – threads of belonging with mini waiba tamang explore belonging through weaving and storytelling in a hands-on session guided by mini waiba tamang.
Alliance Française, Pulchowk, registration required, instagram »


sat 3pm: WORKSHOP – clay & coffee: clay painting workshop decorate a fired ceramic slab with your own design, with materials, guidance, and coffee or tea included.
Pratibimba, Thamel, registration required, instagram »


sat 3:30pm: WORKSHOP – one page comic storytelling workshop a two-day session with illustrator and comic artist prakash ranjit, guiding participants through creating a comic strip or one-page comic.
Dalai-la Art Space, Thamel, charges apply, registration required, instagram »


sat 4pm: FILM – non-fiction now! a double screening featuring split ends by rajan kathet and come over for a drink, kanchhi by sikuma rai, presented as part of film southasia’s pre-festival screening series.
Kathaharu, Lalitpur, free entry, instagram »


sat 8pm: MUSIC – april rush collective a live acoustic jam bringing together roots, rock, and reggae.
Jazz Upstairs, Lazimpat, instagram »


sat: SOCIAL – oops wrong party dress as someone you are not, stay in character, and spend the evening meeting new people at this themed social.
The Bar Room, Thamel, registration required, instagram »

sunday – september 27

sun 12pm: SOCIAL – jigsaw sunday spend a relaxed afternoon solving jigsaw puzzles together while helping raise funds for families affected by recent floods.
Kathmandu Guest House, Thamel, registration required, instagram »


sun 5:30pm: MUSIC – nada yoga: dhrupad sandhya an evening of dhrupad classical music with vocal performances by inoue sou and vishal bhattarai, accompanied by rakesh shakya and yaman sinjali on pakhawaj.
Taragaon Next, Boudha, instagram »


sun 5:30pm: SPORT – women’s night run a women’s evening run of around 5 km, followed by drinks and a casual hangout with the running community.
Maya Coffee Nepal, Kupondole, registration required, instagram »

monday – september 28

mon 8pm: MUSIC – dialogue of strings & rhythm an indian classical performance by amitesh basu and sudip chatterjee, bringing mohan veena and tabla together in a duet.
Jazz Upstairs, Lazimpat, instagram »

tuesday – september 29

tue 3pm: TALK – cosmic wonder: conversations on astrology, healing and meditation an artist session with jimmy thapa exploring astrology, healing, meditation, and spiritual practice through conversation.
Nepal Art Council, Babarmahal, registration required, instagram »


tue 5:30pm: FILM – everest, the mother goddess a documentary following orianne aymard’s journey toward climbing everest after a cerebral hemorrhage changed the course of her life, followed by a q&a with aymard.
Alliance Française, Pulchowk, free entry

wednesday – september 30

wed 2pm: TALK – new insights into mustang’s past researchers from the french-nepalese archaeological mission in mustang share recent findings from their work, followed by an open q&a.
Alliance Française, Pulchowk, registration required, site »


wed 6:30pm: SOCIAL – intentional dating a social dining event for ages 35+, with three courses and three one-on-one conversations over dinner.
Mercure Kathmandu, Sukedhara Heights, registration required, instagram »

thursday – october 1

(no listings today)

ongoing

until october 3: EXHIBITION – a different place works by 35 international artists from the manang artist residency, with proceeds from selected artwork sales supporting disaster relief.

The Kala Salon, Chhaya Center, Thamel, instagram »


until october 10: EXHIBITION – deities of nepal: lores & legends discover the stories and legends behind nepal’s deities and their place in local culture and traditions.

Nepal Art Council, Babarmahal, instagram »


until october 11: EXHIBITION – abhibyanjana: between reality and perception a solo exhibition by avinash vishvakarma exploring the space between reality, memory, perception, and lived experience through color and form.
Annapurna Art, Radhe Radhe, Bhaktapur, instagram »


until october 11: THEATER – shree bijjo bhoot a nepali theatre production presented by mandala theatre and suvakasha pictures.
Mandala Theatre, Thapagaun, registration required, instagram »


until october 31: EXHIBITION – what empire took, what empire left a group exhibition examining the displacement and return of sacred objects and cultural heritage across south asia, from colonial collecting and illicit markets to questions of restitution, memory, belief, and sovereignty.

Taragaon Next, Boudha, instagram »

open registrations

¡OPEN REGISTRATION!: COMMUNITY – ugly art night: recycled & ridiculous happening october 3 at 5pm, make strange sculptures, useless inventions, creatures, decor, or anything else from reused and leftover materials. no art skills needed.
Art Cafe @ Sattya, Jawalakhel, registration required, site »


¡OPEN REGISTRATION!: SPORT – trek with duluwa: nar phu happening october 9–17, a women-only trek through remote himalayan landscapes, ancient villages, and monasteries. limited seats.

Nar Phu Valley, Manang, registration required, instagram »


¡OPEN REGISTRATION!: FILM – certificate in documentary film a six-month part-time documentary film program offering practical training in documentary cinema, with limited scholarships available.
Docskool, registration required, instagram »

opportunities

OPPORTUNITY – 3d animation course scholarship a fully funded, one-year in-person course for a-level and +2 graduates. women and lgbtqia+ applicants are especially encouraged to apply.

Chhauni, apply by september 30, instagram »


OPEN CALL – serai residency a fully funded 2–4 week himalayan residency for writers, artists, educators, and changemakers from the global south, with accommodation, meals, and workspace provided.

Himachal Pradesh, India, apply by september 30, instagram »


OPPORTUNITY – admin / teaching assistant a full-time role at drawing room supporting day-to-day administration and teaching activities. applicants should send a cv and brief interest letter.
Gyanmandala, Jhamsikhel, apply by october 5, instagram »


OPPORTUNITY – production assistant intern a three-month internship with jazz productions offering hands-on experience across production tasks, with opportunities to build videography, editing, and communication skills. applicants should have basic video skills, their own laptop, and transportation.
Lalitpur, instagram »


OPEN CALL – auction for a cause artists and creators are invited to submit original paintings, illustrations, traditional and contemporary art, mixed media, and other creative works that tell a story. only 25 artworks will be selected for the auction.
Islington College, Kumari Hall, instagram »

make something, watch something, run somewhere, meet someone. see you around this week!

item.content:encoded:

fri 11am: TALK – craft matters: culture preservation in art and craft a panel exploring how art and craft can preserve cultural heritage while engaging with contemporary practices.

Bachelor of Craft and Design Building, Patan, instagram »


fri 3pm: TALK – resilience: k garne? dzongsar jamyang khyentse rinpoche explores art, cinema, storytelling, and the resilience of nepali culture in a two-day talk series.

CYF School, Godavari, registration required, instagram »

Pratibimba, Thamel, registration required, instagram »

Taragaon Next, Boudha, registration required, instagram »


sat 4pm: SOCIAL – your bollywood trivia night test your knowledge of 2010–2020 bollywood films and dress as your favorite character for a chance to win a prize.

Vivanta Kathmandu, Jhamsikhel, registration required, instagram »


sat: WORKSHOP – painting workshop a two-day painting session with marcel wissing and dipesh nepali in support of flood-affected communities. runs september 19–20.

Patan Durbar Square, instagram »

(no listings today)

monday – september 21

(no listings today)

tuesday – september 22

tue 5:30pm: THEATER – Shree Bijjo Bhoot a nepali theatre production presented by mandala theatre and suvakasha pictures. runs september 22–october 11.

wed 7:47am: FESTIVAL – indra jatra the festival begins with the raising of a sacred pole at basantapur, followed by an afternoon procession honoring departed loved ones with clay lamps.

wed 7pm: MUSIC – ghazal night a weekly live ghazal music evening at musicology, featuring vocals, guitar, and tabla.

thu 2pm: FESTIVAL – yenya punhi utsav celebrate indra jatra, a traditional newar festival honoring the rain god indra, with a community gathering celebrating local culture and heritage.

Nayabazar,Thamel, free entry, instagram »


thu 5:30pm: FILM – all your faces a french drama exploring restorative justice through conversations between victims and offenders, confronting anger, vulnerability, and the possibility of healing.

Alliance Française, Pulchowk, free entry, site »

ongoing

until september 20: EXHIBITION – felting memories of culture eight artists transform traditional felt craft into artworks exploring personal stories and cultural memory.

Sarwoshrestha Gallery, Swayambhu, instagram »


until september 20: EXHIBITION – diary of sketches discover everyday life in nepal through the eyes of sri lankan artist prageeth manohansa, captured in mixed media sketches during his two-month residency.

Siddhartha Art Gallery, Babar Mahal Revisited, instagram »


until september 20: EXHIBITION – myth & memory a solo exhibition by bivas rai exploring kirati oral traditions, cultural memory, and the relationship between ritual, movement, and nature.

Siddhartha Art Gallery, Babar Mahal Revisited, instagram »


until october 31: EXHIBITION – what empire took, what empire left a group exhibition examining the displacement and return of sacred objects and cultural heritage across south asia, from colonial collecting and illicit markets to questions of restitution, memory, belief, and sovereignty.

Taragaon Next, Boudha, instagram »

The Kala Salon, Chhaya Center, Thamel, instagram »

Nepal Art Council, Babarmahal, instagram »

open registrations

¡OPEN REGISTRATION!: WORKSHOP – carve. ink. print. with jyotsna happening september 26 at 1pm, learn to design, carve, and print your own lino-block designs on paper and fabric with artist jyotsna udas. all materials provided.

Sattya Media Arts Collective, Jawalakhel, registration required, site »


¡OPEN REGISTRATION!: WORKSHOP – threads of belonging with mini waiba tamang happening september 26 at 3pm, explore belonging through weaving and storytelling in a hands-on session. basic materials provided.

Alliance Française, Pulchowk, charges apply, registration required, instagram »


¡OPEN REGISTRATION!: SPORT – trek with duluwa: nar phu happening october 9–17, a women-only trek through remote himalayan landscapes, ancient villages, and monasteries. limited seats.

Nar Phu Valley, Manang, registration required, instagram »

apply by september 23, instagram »

Chhauni, apply by september 30, instagram »

item.title: september 11 - september 17
item.description: your no-frills community newsletter for art + culture events around kathmandu, every fri-thurs.
item.content:encoded:
friday – september 11

fri 4pm: MUSIC – fridays at the lab a friday music session featuring foeseal, chau baba, and gentle g.

The Lab, Labim Mall, instagram »


fri 7pm: MUSIC – music nights: old skool a classic hip hop night featuring knifeturtle on the village café rooftop.

The Village Café Rooftop, Jhamsikhel, instagram »


fri: FILM – licchavi cinema festival an international film festival bringing together films, filmmakers, artists, and audiences from nepal, asia, and beyond. runs september 11–15.

QFX Cinemas, Chhaya Center, Thamel, instagram »

saturday – september 12

sat 7am: SPORT – kalu pandey danda hike a 3.5-hour group hike to kalu pandey danda, followed by lunch and transport back to swayambhu.

Swayambhu, registration required, instagram »


sat 12pm: MARKET – q&a with artists & art market a q&a with artists followed by an art market featuring arts and crafts, pottery, felt needling, food, and drinks.

Mellow Pomelo, Swayambhu, instagram »


sat 1pm: LITERATURE – booked n busy a reading meetup inviting you to bring your current read, spend some quiet time reading together, and connect with fellow book lovers. donations of children’s books, stationery, and relief items are also being collected.

Kamal Pokhari, free entry, registration required, instagram »


sat 2pm: COMMUNITY – finish that thing bring an unfinished creative project and spend the afternoon working alongside others, with conversation, company, and a moral support to help you finally make some progress.

Art Cafe @ Sattya, Jawalakhel, registration required, instagram »


sat 2pm: WORKSHOP – macrame workshop a beginner-friendly hands-on workshop introducing macrame techniques through making your own plant hanger. all materials and light snacks are included.

Kalashala, Sanepa Chowk, charges apply, registration required, instagram »


sat 6pm: WORKSHOP – moonlamp workshop a beginner-friendly moonlamp workshop guided by red string, with all art materials and refreshments included. open to ages 18 and above, with limited spots.

Tangerine Brunch and Bar, Bakhundole, registration required, instagram »


sat 8pm: MUSIC – the walkman trio a live jazz trio featuring abhisek bhadra on keys and synths, rajat rai on bass, and sudhir acharya on drums. the evening is also a charity show supporting rasuwa flood relief.

Jazz Upstairs, Lazimpat, instagram »


sat: MUSIC – amit jung & the gorkhey a live music night featuring amit jung & the gorkhey at eden.

Eden, Sanepa, registration required, instagram »


sat: EXHIBITION – shangri-la international art exhibition 2026 an international group exhibition bringing together works by artists from across asia and beyond. runs september 12–16.

Taragaon Next, Boudha, free entry, instagram »


sat: MUSIC – echoes of bollywood: monali thakur a live performance by indian playback singer monali thakur, featuring songs from her bollywood repertoire.

Club Nova, Thamel, instagram »

sunday – september 13

sun 6:30am: SPORT – sari run 2026 a 3 km fun road run celebrating teej with the running community, organized by centauro run club.

350 Fahrenheit Bakers, registration required, instagram »


sun 3pm: TALK – looking nepal through polycrisis: technology, economy and politics a research seminar examining nepal through interconnected questions of technology, economy, and politics, featuring ojaswi kc, maneet dhungel, santosh adhikari, and bhaskar gautam.

Martin Chautari, Thapathali, instagram »

monday – september 14

mon 6am: FESTIVAL – hartalika teej a major teej celebration at pashupatinath, where devotees gather from early morning for worship, fasting, rituals, and traditional festivities.

Pashupatinath temple, Gaushala, instagram »

tuesday – september 15

tue 4:35pm: TALK – dharma and cinema a conversation with shelnang mugum tamang and tsering ritar sherpa exploring the relationship between dharma and cinema, following a screening of the cup.

QFX Cinemas, Chhaya Center, Thamel, instagram »


tue: FESTIVAL – ganesh chaturthi: chathaa a festival marking the birthday of ganesh, observed by newar communities with special evening rituals, family gatherings, and a shared feast, and often regarded as a mini dashain.

Ganesh temples, various locations, instagram »

wednesday – september 16

wed 10:30am: COMMUNITY – happa blankets a weekly community knitting and crocheting session making warm winter blankets for pregnant women, babies, and young children affected by recent floods in nepal. beginners are welcome, just bring your own yarn.

kar.maCOFFEE Patan, Jhamsikhel, free entry, registration required, instagram »


wed 7pm: MUSIC – ghazal night a weekly live ghazal music evening at musicology, featuring vocals, guitar, and tabla.

Musicology, instagram »


wed 8pm: MUSIC – midweek jazz a midweek live jazz session by le piro at jazz upstairs.

Jazz Upstairs, Lazimpat, instagram »

thursday – september 17

thu 10am: EXHIBITION – paintings of kathmandu & rural nepal opening of the exhibition by wibo arte, marcel wissing boada, featuring paintings inspired by kathmandu and rural nepal. runs until september 26.

Patan Durbar Square, registration required, instagram »


thu 5pm: FILM – the journey within part of film southasia’s non-fiction now! pre-festival screening series which follows the beginnings of coke studio in pakistan. stay after the screening for an open discussion around the film, the music, and the questions it raises.

Loft @ Sattya, Jawalakhel, free entry, site »


thu 5:30pm: FILM – my mum is a bodybuilder a documentary by prashanna shakya following a 41-year-old newar mother in bhaktapur as she challenges social expectations to pursue bodybuilding, filmed and co-authored by her two young sons. followed by a q&a with the team.

Alliance Française, Jawalakhel, free entry, site »


thu: SOCIAL – salsa night a weekly thursday salsa night with music, dancing, and a social atmosphere at london pub.

London Pub, Durbarmarg, instagram »

ongoing

until september 20: EXHIBITION – myth & memory a solo exhibition by bivas rai exploring kirati oral traditions, cultural memory, and the relationship between ritual, movement, and nature.

Siddhartha Art Gallery, Babar Mahal Revisited, instagram »


until october 31: EXHIBITION – what empire took, what empire left a group exhibition examining the displacement and return of sacred objects and cultural heritage across south asia, from colonial collecting and illicit markets to questions of restitution, memory, belief, and sovereignty.

Taragaon Next, Boudha, instagram »

open registrations

¡OPEN REGISTRATION!: WORKSHOP – queer public speaking training a fully funded three-day residential training for pomsogiesc youth aged 18–35, focused on public speaking, storytelling, media engagement, advocacy, leadership, and confidence building.

free, registration required, apply by september 16, instagram »


¡OPEN REGISTRATION!: SPORT – lsd: honor thy friends happening september 18, a backyard ultra fundraiser where every kilometer run generates financial support for people in need. limited to 50 participants.

CYF School, Godavari, registration required, instagram »


¡OPEN REGISTRATION!: WORKSHOP – portrait drawing masterclass starting september 20, a 15-day beginner-friendly masterclass covering facial proportions, sketching, shading, light and shadow, textures, expressions, and techniques for creating realistic portraits. all materials are provided.

The Drawing Room, Khichapokhari, registration required, instagram »

opportunities

OPEN CALL – himalayan story lab 2026–2027 an open call for filmmakers from the himalayan regions of india, bhutan, and nepal who are developing feature documentary projects.

online, apply by september 15, instagram »


OPPORTUNITY – certificate in documentary film a six-month part-time program by docskool exploring documentary cinema and visual storytelling, with sessions starting in november.
Airavat Picture House, Thapathali, apply by september 15, instagram »


GRANT – general category grants: the inception grant five grants for emerging south asian artists working across contemporary mediums, with financial support and professional development to help strengthen their practice. open to artists aged 21–35 from nepal, india, bangladesh, sri lanka, and bhutan.
online, apply by september 15, instagram »


OPPORTUNITY – fsa’26 internship an internship with film southasia offering hands-on experience in documentary film festival programming, events, and festival coordination. a modest stipend is provided, and women and applicants from marginalized communities are encouraged to apply.

apply by september 20, instagram »


OPPORTUNITY – regional curatorial fellowship a seven-month paid fellowship for early-career curators and cultural practitioners working across photography, visual culture, and gender justice, with opportunities to contribute to exhibitions, editorial work, and curatorial decisions. the remote, part-time fellowship begins in october 2026, with a stipend of up to £3,000.

online, apply by september 22, instagram »


OPPORTUNITY – content creator & social media trainee a part-time trainee role focused on event coverage, social media content, reels, video editing, captions, and platform management for personal and corporate events. freshers are welcome to apply.

Sanepa, instagram »

as communities continue to recover from the floods, there are still many ways to help. show up for local relief events, support community-led efforts, or contribute to the prime minister’s disaster relief fund.

item.title: september 4 - september 10
item.description: your no-frills community newsletter for art + culture events around kathmandu, every fri-thurs.
item.content:encoded:
friday – september 4

fri 11am: FESTIVAL – saparu jatra 2026 a day-long celebration of bhaktapur’s saparu tradition with a ghintang ghisi procession, costume competition, food stalls, live music, and a traditional newari laptey bhoj.

Newa Delights, Bhaktapur, registration required, instagram »


fri 5pm: EXHIBITION – made in mind: narratives of the contemporary a group exhibition bringing together 15 artists exploring contemporary life through memory, identity, perception, experience, and imagination. runs until september 21.

Gallery Mcube, Lalitpur, charges apply, instagram »


fri 5pm: FILM – crazy a free screening of the german coming-of-age film crazy as part of goethe-zentrum kathmandu’s friday movie screening series.

Goethe-Zentrum Kathmandu, Thapathali, free entry, instagram »


fri 6pm: WORKSHOP – kintsugi workshop a hands-on evening that starts with breaking objects in the smash room, then puts the pieces back together through kintsugi, the japanese art of repairing broken pottery.

The Smash Room, Balkumari, charges apply, registration required, instagram »


fri 7pm: MUSIC – music nights: romance & breakups an r&b and 2000s singalong night with pranez tamu, bringing familiar love songs, heartbreak anthems, and throwback favorites to the village café rooftop.

The Village Café Rooftop, Jhamsikhel, charges apply, instagram »


fri 7pm: MUSIC – reggae revival a friday night reggae session with rajat and zimba, bringing laid-back rhythms, drinks, and an easygoing beer garden atmosphere.

Electric Pagoda, Thamel, charges apply, instagram »

saturday – september 5

sat 6am: WELLNESS – yoga hike a guided day hike from sanga to panauti with scenic trails, local stories, an outdoor yoga session with navin, and a community newari lunch in panauti.

Avata Wellness Center, Baluwatar, registration required, instagram »


sat 12pm: MARKET – garden socials weekend market a relaxed weekend market with local vendors, makers, food, and plenty of space to browse, eat, and spend the afternoon.

Garden Project, Bhanimandal, free entry, instagram »


sat 3pm: WORKSHOP – kinusaiga workshop a hands-on introduction to the japanese art of kinusaiga, using fabric scraps to create decorative artwork without stitching. all materials and light snacks are included.

Kalashala, Sanepa Chowk, charges apply, instagram »


sat 5pm: COMMUNITY – the pause café a community gathering to slow down, connect, play, and spend time together while raising support for families affected by recent floods.

Winston’s Speakeasy, Sanepa, registration required, instagram »


sat 8pm: MUSIC – swatkais featuring nami adhikari a live set blending jazz, funk, and contemporary influences, featuring nami adhikari at jazz upstairs.

Jazz Upstairs, Lazimpat, charges apply, instagram »

sunday – september 6

sun 7:30am: WORKSHOP – growing starts a ten-sunday community program centered on getting your hands in the soil, learning to grow together, and building community through shared practice.

Pranali Space, Yellow House Backyard, Sanepa, registration required, instagram »


sun 1pm: FOOD – forgotten foods of nepal cooking experience a hands-on cooking experience exploring lesser-known and forgotten foods of nepal, with a chance to learn about ingredients, recipes, and food traditions that are often left out of everyday menus.

Raithaane, Nextdoor Thamel, charges apply, instagram »


sun 3pm: WORKSHOP – photo fridge magnet workshop a father’s day special for kids aged 5–14 to design a personalized photo fridge magnet and make small handmade gifts. all materials are included.

Kalashala, Sanepa, registration required, instagram »

monday – september 7

mon 6am: SPORT – weekly tr run a weekly community running session starting from salesberry tower, open to those looking to get moving and run together.

Salesberry Tower, Maharajgunj, charges apply, instagram »


mon 1pm: COMMUNITY – folklores of ancient patan tour a guided walk through patan exploring local stories, legends, and folklore connected to the city’s old neighborhoods and heritage.

Nextdoor Patan, instagram »

tuesday – september 8

tue 1pm: TALK – ghera: open space discussion an open public discussion marking one year since the september 8, 2025 gen z revolution, creating space for memory, mourning, dialogue, and collective questioning. the gathering also includes 76 chalk outlines by rupesh man singh.

Nepal Point, free entry, instagram »


tue 2pm: FOOD – dinner, please! an interactive german culture session exploring dining etiquette, cultural misunderstandings, and the unwritten rules of eating together through playful activities and conversation.

Thapathali, charges apply, instagram »


tue 3pm: THEATER – playback theatre a participatory performance inviting people to share and listen to stories connected to the september 8, 2025 gen z protest in nepal, which are then brought to life on stage. the event is also a fundraiser for people affected by recent flash floods.

Kausi Theater, Teku, registration required, instagram »

wednesday – september 9

wed 3pm: WORKSHOP – crochet circle a weekly crochet gathering to work on your own project, practice together, and spend the afternoon making alongside others.

Taragaon Next, Boudha, free entry, registration required, instagram »


wed 7:30pm: SOCIAL – salsa & bachata wednesdays a weekly social dance evening for salsa and bachata, with space to dance, practice, and meet others.

The Watering Hole, Jhamsikhel, charges apply, instagram »


wed 8pm: MUSIC – jazz night: le piro a midweek live jazz night featuring le piro at jazz upstairs.
